fsd_mv_2023.title: Fire Safety Requirements for Mechanical Ventilating Systems
fsd_mv_2023.review_scope: Clauses7.3/7.4,PDF page14,printed page11;individual sourced inventory assertions only
fsd_mv_2023.applicability_note: Project works/date/scope and amendment applicability require an explicit decision;website listing is not a complete legal applicability determination

rules.scope: Declared flexible ducts used as main distribution
rules.alternative_path_note: A declared flexible main-distribution duct conflicts with the selected prohibition;revise and independently review the design. No waiver is inferred.

rules.scope: Declared flexible-duct penetrations through fire-resisting walls,floors,ceilings or partitions
rules.alternative_path_note: A declared flexible connection penetrates a fire-resisting boundary;revise and independently review the design. A short length does not clear this prohibition.

rules.scope: Declared direct flexible-duct connections to fire or fire-and-smoke dampers
rules.alternative_path_note: A declared flexible connection terminates directly at a fire or fire-and-smoke damper;revise and independently review the design. No approval is inferred.
